messages:
alex: Anyone seen reservation R-2026-87 get reassigned? we just lost 8 A100s from prod-pool and jobs are failing :grimacing:
reservation-bot: Reservation R-2026-87 status changed -> reassigned to project `research-sandbox` by kevin at 2026-07-05T14:12:23Z
maria: looking... which region?
alex: us-central1
maria: i can see an admin reassignment in the audit logs. user=kevin@redwood.internal reason='manual handoff - urgent research spike'
sam: wait, that reservation is under our reserved commit (monthly commit id C-88). moving it breaks the committed discount math. lisa-finance, fyi
lisa-finance: yep that's a problem — that reservation is part of the Q3 committed pool. any manual reassignments need approval from finance or the infra lead. cost impact could be ~$14k/day if left like this
jordan: ops question: do we have an automatic fallback policy for prod when reserved capacity disappears?
maria: currently we fallback to on-demand burst in same region but we throttle to keep SLOs and avoid runaway billing. right now a bunch of tasks are in Pending because the scheduler tried to bind to the reservation and failed
kevin: sorry folks — i handed 8 GPUs to research to finish a hot eval. i thought we had spare margin. i can revert now if infra approves
alex: please revert. prod jobs are blocked. we can't take the finance hit and SLA risk
maria: kevin, please don't reassign through console. i need to rotate the reservation binding properly or we'll create split-brain. i'll run the revert and rebind flow in 10m.
sam: also we need a postmortem of why the console allowed this without warning. maybe show a confirmation showing "part of committed pool"
maria: i already filed a knee-jerk policy change: revoke the `reservations.reassign` permission from non-infra groups. will follow up in PR
reservation-bot: created ticket INFRA-1229 "Investigate manual reservation reassignments + permission tightening" assigned to @maria
lisa-finance: we also need to open a billing investigation with cloud provider to preserve committed discount for the day. can someone attach the `commit-usage` logs and reservation binding times?
maria: attaching minimal logs here:
```
AUDIT: 2026-07-05T14:12:23Z user=kevin action="reassign_reservation" reservation=R-2026-87 target_project=research-sandbox
AUDIT: 2026-07-05T14:12:47Z scheduler bind_attempt job=ml-train-992 res=R-2026-87 -> FAIL
AUDIT: 2026-07-05T14:13:01Z fallback=start on-demand-burst region=us-central1
```
alex: timeline looks right. maria, can you revert and then we'll coordinate a controlled handoff window if research legitimately needs temporary capacity?
maria: reverting now. running `infra-reserve revert --id R-2026-87 --force` (will hand back to prod binding)
```
> infra-reserve revert --id R-2026-87 --force
INFO: unbinding from research-sandbox
INFO: rebinding to prod-pool
SUCCESS: reservation R-2026-87 rebound at 2026-07-05T14:20:05Z
```
kevin: thanks, that was my bad. research hit an unexpected load and pinged me hard. won't do again without sign-off
jordan: follow-ups: 1) short-term: restrict manual reassignment (maria already on it) 2) medium: console UX that shows "part of committed reservation C-88" tooltip and blocks without approval 3) long-term: cross-project burst policy with auto-chargeback
lisa-finance: i'll open a billing ticket with provider referencing the audit lines and ask for commitment preservation for 2026-07-05. assigning to `cloud-billing` and CC infra.
sam: also let's add a reserve-queue priority tag so urgent evals can request a transient slot instead of stealing reservation. maybe `priority:transient` with TTL
maria: created RFC draft: /docs/rfcs/2026-07-transient-reservation-requests (will post link after tidy)
alex: great. for now, thanks for the revert. please confirm once cloud billing acknowledges preservation so we can close the finance ticket
lisa-finance: will update here once we have ticket number. estimated SLA from provider is 48h for commit disputes
kevin: apology again :bow: i'll sync with research lead to coordinate requests through the proper channel
maria: action items: (1) infra PR to revoke reassignment perm (2) console UX warning (3) reserve-queue transient feature RFC (4) open cloud billing dispute - lisa to lead (5) postmortem note - sam to write. tagging owners.
alex: :raised_hands: thanks team
reservation-bot: INFRA-1229 updated: status=investigating assigned=maria
sam: quick note — if anyone needs the temporary 2-hour burst before policy is in place, ping oncall and include `cost-cover` ack from finance otherwise we won't permit it
jordan: noted. i'll add that to the RFC as the emergency flow
lisa-finance: billing ticket created: CB-449012 - referenced audit logs, asked for commitment preservation for 2026-07-05. CC: infra.
maria: closing loop: reservation is back in prod, scheduler drained backlog, jobs resumed at 14:23:xx. i'll post the PR link when opened
alex: closing here after PR link + billing confirmation :eyes:
